Inputs are official daily fixings resolved per provider precedence; each source's own licence terms apply and are recorded in Odun's data_source registry.
Weekend-dated source rows are excluded before computation; the series contains trading days only.
An absent trading day is a gap and is never imputed; no missing date, value, or horizon is filled in, and 120x1d stays absent until mature.
60x1d and 120x1d are trading-day counts, roughly three and six calendar months; they are not 60 or 120 calendar days.
Relative currency returns are the zero-sum rank-seven solution of the direct-pair fixing system; they are not standalone market prices.
Strength rank measures cumulative 5x1d relative log return; it is descriptive and not a forecast.
Volatility-adjusted strength divides the 5x1d cumulative return by trailing 20x1d sample volatility times sqrt(5).
Strength deltas compare rolling cross-sectional z-scores one and three trading days apart; persistence is capped at five periods.
EMA3, EMA6, and EMA12 are computed on an internally reconstructed synthetic log index; only current derived levels cross the boundary.
Pair differentials are current base-currency strength z minus quote-currency strength z; they are investigation context, not entry quality or pair direction.

Strength uses five weekly return bars; delta1/delta3 and EMA3/6/12 are weekly bar counts.
60x1w and 120x1w are observed weekly-return counts, not calendar-year labels.
Each return uses two adjacent eligible ISO-week buckets; missing source weeks are never bridged into one-week returns.
Relative currency returns are the zero-sum rank-seven direct-pair solve, not standalone market prices.
Pair differentials are base-currency strength z minus quote-currency strength z; they are not entry quality or pair direction.
Restated basis: every input is latest-vintage-restated (census Q3 verdict); is_point_in_time is false and captured_at is capture time, never publication time.
Descriptive only; every forecast, decision and execution-authority flag is false.
Policy-rate observation dates are series dates, not decision dates; last_change_date is a window-bounded Forge-derived field.
NZ/CH 10Y is the monthly OECD IRLT series and is never comparable to a daily curve.
GB declares no 2Y sovereign-yield tenor; yields.2Y is null for GBP.
Weekend and holiday rows carry the prior observation with its staleness disclosed.
No tenor is interpolated or substituted; a missing observation is null with a reason.
No field is a return, funding or expected-move statistic.
